interpretation.current_rule_behavior: No DATA-02 (or any other) finding was emitted for either version when the single C++ FFI implementation file was analyzed by the current B/IPC detector.
interpretation.why_no_finding: The detector is an IPC entry-to-effect analyzer whose current design expects source-indexed dispatch or other modeled roots. This C++ binding contains the vulnerable allocation/writes but no recognized dispatcher in this one-file input. The detector's completed status and zero findings here do not mean the function is safe; the source-level under-allocation established by the !2037 diff remains a scanner coverage gap for this invocation.
interpretation.scope_nuance: cpp implementation file is technically supported; Cangjie language inputs themselves are not. Language support does not imply that all memory-safety operations in the binding are modeled by the IPC rule set.
interpretation.family_mapping: DATA-02 ipc.parcel.bounds is the closest rule family conceptually. The probe does not demonstrate a rule firing. No new rule work was done.
interpretation.eligibility: This is an exploratory single-file probe, not a frozen holdout replay and not a product scan. No holdout entry or accuracy label is implied.
